text.text:
I wasn't sure about the trip at first.
The weather looked terrible all week.
And we'd already cancelled twice.
But on Saturday morning the sky cleared.
So we packed the car and drove up the coast.
We stopped for coffee in a tiny town with one street and a bakery that sold out by 9.
By the afternoon we were walking along the cliffs.
Watching the waves crash below us.
Honestly.
It was the best day I've had in months.
And I can't wait to go back.
